label: Lucius - Oura Sync
info:
Runs every 4 hours, anchored to 10am (10,14,18,22,2,6). Fetches oura_client_id/oura_client_secret fresh from GoDaddy's api/get_shared_config.php each run (PLAN.md §3 — GoDaddy is the source of truth for these, no longer hand-copied locally), pulls high-fidelity Oura data into InfluxDB, pushes summary fields to GoDaddy, logs job start/finish to InfluxDB, updates HA status entities.

UNTESTED — built from the proven PHP logic in godaddy/app/oura.php but never run against a live Node-RED/InfluxDB/Oura stack. Verify the schedule trigger's cron expression in the editor after import (Node-RED's inject-node schedule UI has changed across versions) and test each HTTP Request node's config against your actual Node-RED version before trusting it end to end.

name: Load secrets + start job log
Prepare get_shared_config.php request
Merge fetched values into msg.secrets
Prepare InfluxDB start-point write
InfluxDB: write start point
comment: url/method/headers/payload set dynamically by the preceding 'Prepare InfluxDB start-point write' function via msg.url/msg.method/msg.headers/msg.payload. If this still shows 'No url specified' after redeploying, the fix didn't take -- check that this node's wiring actually comes from n_oura_prep_start_point_write, not directly from n_oura_merge_shared_config.

name: Check token expiry
Save refreshed token to secrets file
Prepare Oura API requests (3 endpoints)
Store sleep resp, prepare activity request
Store activity resp, prepare readiness request
Build InfluxDB lines + GoDaddy summary
Prepare InfluxDB batch write
Prepare GoDaddy push
Log success + update HA status
Log failure + update HA status
Prepare finish-point write
Split entities for HA WebSocket node
Call HA service (set helper entity)
comment: Deprecated 'ha-entity' node replaced with the core api-call-service ("action") node. FIX (Aug 2026): this node's stale domain/service/target/data/domainType/serviceType/targetType/dataFieldType properties are leftover from an OLDER version of this node's schema and don't do anything on Ward's installed version — confirmed via his own screenshot of the editor (Action/Targets/Data all showed genuinely empty, not just unset). The preceding function node now sends everything as a single msg.payload = { action, target, data } object instead, which the newer node reads directly and which overrides its UI config regardless of what's left in these stale properties (per the node's own docs) — so it's fine to leave Action/Targets/Data blank in the editor. The one thing that still MUST be set manually per install, and can't be pre-filled from JSON: the 'Server' field — open this node and select your HA connection.
